name: com.gtxagent/gtxagent-mcp
description: Paid x402 crypto tools for agents; catalogue is keyless, data needs a key.

tools.name: token_safety
tools.description: Is this token safe to buy? Ownership powers, holder concentration, honeypot and liquidity flags for one token before an agent swaps, sends or accepts it. Price $0.03 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required: without one the call is refused, because the upstream purchase is real.

tools.name: token_price
tools.description: Live token price and market data for one or more coin ids or tickers, for agents that need a USD number before sizing a position. Price $0.04 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required: without one the call is refused, because the upstream purchase is real.

tools.name: market_open
tools.description: Is this exchange open right now? Whether a named venue is trading at a given instant, with local time and the next holiday, so an agent never trades a closed market. Price $0.015 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required: without one the call is refused, because the upstream purchase is real.

tools.name: agent_recommend
tools.description: Which x402 API should the agent call for this task? A ranked, compact recommendation with rationale and price, so an agent spends once instead of probing five endpoints. Price $0.02 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required: without one the call is refused, because the upstream purchase is real.

need.description: What the agent needs to do

tools.name: trending_coins
tools.description: What is moving in crypto right now? Trending coins with rank, price and market-cap rank for agents scanning for momentum or writing a market summary. Price $0.04 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required: without one the call is refused, because the upstream purchase is real.

tools.name: whale_coverage
tools.description: Can this whale-flow dataset answer my question? Coverage summary with asset classes, symbol count and the exact time range, before an agent pays for data. Price $0.02 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required: without one the call is refused, because the upstream purchase is real.

tools.name: market_pulse
tools.description: What are Base tokens trading at right now? Live USDC quotes for every supported token, with unavailable legs named. Price $0.01 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required; there are no free data calls.

tools.name: token_registry
tools.description: Which tokens can I trade here? Symbol, address, decimals and status for every allowed Base token. Price $0.005 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required; there are no free data calls.

tools.name: token_decision
tools.description: Should I buy or skip this Base token? One deterministic yes/no over 24h with confidence, reasons and sources. Price $0.01 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required; there are no free data calls.

tools.name: token_quote
tools.description: What is this token worth and where is it? One token's contract, decimals and latest USDC quote. Price $0.002 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required; there are no free data calls.

tools.name: strategy_catalog
tools.description: Which daily research signals does GTXAgent sell? Krokus and Prepa: thesis, as_of, freshness, active count, price, universe size and where to call them. The same catalogue is free over HTTP at /x402/strategy. Free without a key; it is a catalogue, not live data.

tools.name: strategy_krokus
tools.description: The Krokus daily funding-flush signal: side, entry, stop, target and time exit for fired rows, walk-forward thresholds, the features that decided it, the failed conditions for flat rows, OOS stats, max drawdown and the paper ledger, with as_of and a staleness flag. Research, not an execution instruction. Price $0.02 USDC, charged from your prepaid credits. A key is required; there are no free data calls.

include.description: active (default) = signals that fired; all = the full table
